features: Morphe-style updates timeline on the updates screen: summary pills, expandable per-release rows, a pinned GitHub/Download bar, and relative dates.
Demo timeline fixture so the updates timeline can be exercised without a live release feed.
Headed release notes now backfill the `releases` array in the update manifest.
fixes: Release dates compare as UTC calendar days, so the timeline is not off by one across daylight-saving transitions.
optimizations: Release notes are discovered by glob and ordered by numeric version, so new releases join the timeline without a publisher code change.

features: Web pages opened from the app (credits, management keys, model pages, release page, privacy/terms, and other help links) now always open in the in-app browser so you stay in the app.
If your device has no in-app browser available, the app now asks before opening the page in your external browser instead of silently leaving the app.

fixes: Login screen is no longer unmounted behind the app lock — the navigator stays mounted and an opaque cover stands in front of it, so an interrupted biometric prompt or a route change mid-lock can no longer drop an in-flight dialog or half-finished state.
App switcher / recents snapshots are covered on both platforms (`FLAG_SECURE` in release builds, app-switcher shield on both), now without unmounting the app behind the cover.
Demo mode keeps full bottom navigation; the demo banner is placed above the scaffold rather than replacing it.
Sign out and delete local data: a failure is now shown as a snackbar instead of an unhandled exception, and the working state always resets.
Database open errors at startup are reported by type, not raw exception text.
A device without a screen lock is no longer trap-locked out of the app — the app lock is opt-in for upgrades without a lock row.

features: **Demo mode** — configurable session mode with fixture data; no network required.
**App lock with PIN fallback** — grace period, lock screen, PIN unlock if biometric unavailable.
**Screen privacy** — `FLAG_SECURE`, app-switcher snapshot covered; Android screenshots blocked.
**About / Privacy / Terms** — new About page with links; in-app privacy policy and terms.
**Data deletion on sign-out** — "Sign out and delete local data" clears local storage and resets to onboarding.
**Dashboard "Buy credits"** — new billing links (`billingUrl`, `managementKeysPage`) on the dashboard.
